inShort: A and B dink while shuffling together from one sideline to the other. Five sidelines in a row without a miss.
rules: A and B start straight across at the kitchen line, both at the same sideline.
Dink back and forth while you both shuffle sideways toward the other sideline.
Touch the sideline: 1 point for the team. Then shuffle back the other way.
A miss sends the count back to zero.
Close to 5 the pressure rises: relax on purpose and keep your normal swing.
tooEasy: Raise the target to 10. Even harder: one of you dinks with more pressure, the other defends, then switch.
goodLooksLike: Close to the target, the dinks stay as soft and low as at the start, and both of you keep shuffling without stopping.
